balls.text: slower ball bowled full outside off, makes room and slices it over point, some atrocious fielding by the deep-point fielder there who palms it to the ropes sliding to his left
shot! Bowled full on middle, he's already walked across, scoops it well over short fine for a boundary

excellent catch, slower ball bowled short outside off, Dravid made room and struck it well, slapping it past extra cover, but Warne's right at the edge of the circle and stretches and dives to his left to pluck that superbly
massive hit! Length ball on middle, right in the slot for Dravid, makes way and swings it over the deep-midwicket boundary, went about 10-12 rows into the stands

the change of pace does the trick, slower ball bowled full on a length on middle and off, Praveen, predictably, tries to smash that out of Cape Town but didn't pick it well, ended up lofting it really high and Munaf had to take a few steps to his left to take a well-judged catch, took a while to come down
full on middle, drilled down the ground to long-on for a single
short outside off, and it's way too wide, a run gifted
yorker outside off, just outside off, Praveen fails to get his bat down in time
on middle and leg, a touch fuller, worked away towards square
crucial runs these, short and wide, cuts it away wide of a diving point to four more
fullish on middle and leg, driven down the ground wide of long-on for a couple more
gets to his fifty but playing that inside-out over the covers to beat the gap between deep cover and deep point, well done, he's held one end together here
stump-to-stump from the highest wicket-taker in Twenty20 cricket, low full toss on middle, played back to the bowler
chopped down wide of cover for a single, Warne ends an enthralling spell
short of a length on middle, slaps it over the non-striker to long-on
connects well this time, it's flighted and full on middle, gets under it and smashes it back over the bowler's head for the first six of the innings
slightly short on the off, kept a little low, punched to cover
on middle and off, pushed into the off side
swings and misses, Praveen and Dravid are two opposites, flighted on middle and he tries to dismiss that into the stands but the ball zips away to beat him
aiming for the yorker there, but strays in line a little, pushes it on leg stump, Dravid tickles it wide of a squarish fine leg for a couple
full on middle and leg, driven stylishly between deep midwicket and deep square leg for a couple, his shoe comes off as he tries to run back for the second, it's all worth it
back of a length on middle, played down wide of midwicket for a single
short outside off, run down to third man
overpitched this time, on a driving length and Dravid obliges, creaming it through the covers to get a much-needed boundary
full on the off stump, dabbed back onto the pitch
almost threw it away, had a blind swing at it but the spin took it away from him, the bowler has a nice chuckle while Dravid will have asked Praveen to keep himself under control
dropped off the front foot into the leg side
genius! Got him with the flighted one, thrown up on the leg stump sucking him out of the crease, he tried to drive it through the leg side, missed, and the ball spun back in to hit middle and off
close shout for lbw, short outside off, a googly that spun back in sharply, went for the cut, was quick through the air, was rapped on the pads but was struck just outside the line
short of a length on middle, pulled away to deep midwicket
superbly done, tossed up on the off stump, drew him forward, he tried to defend but the ball spun away at the last moment to beat the outside edge
delicately done, short outside off and holding its line, didn't spin but he waited for it and dabbed it past the keeper and short fine, used the pace to perfection to find the boundary
spun back in sharply, tried to whip it wide of square leg, was struck high on the pads
gets back and dabs it down to point
flicked away towards deep midwicket off the front foot
fires it in wide down the leg side, it's called
cheeky, fraction full outside off, reaches forward and paddles it really fine to beat the short-fine fielder to the boundary
slightly short on middle, punched firmly but straight to midwicket
gets front and across and works it wristily wide of midwicket for a single
short of a good length outside off, gets back and chops it down to cover
tossed up on leg stump, ticked short of short fine, Dravid calls well to complete the single and take strike
bowled a touch quicker outside leg, tries to turn it fine, is hit on the pad but they sneak a leg bye
shot! Flighted, lands full on middle, gets down on one knee and sweeps it away fiercely to beat the gap between deep square leg and deep midwicket
held it back a little, dropped it short outside off, chopped towards point
flat, quick and fullish on middle and leg, flicked away to deep square leg
fired in full outside off, makes room and slices it between long-off and deep cover for a couple
fired in quick on middle and leg, whipped away to deep square leg
short of a length outside off, rocks back and chops it down behind point for a couple
played off the back foot towards short third
bowled flat on middle and off, defended back to the bowler
ooh, almost, flighted outside off, gets forward with a lunge but the ball spins away sharply
bowled 'im, tossed up on leg stump, inducing Kohli to step out of the crease, he tries to work it away into the leg side, misses, the ball spins back in to peg back middle
much fuller and on the leg stump, gets back and punches it back to the bowler
short on the off and spinning away from the right hander, slapped down to cover
short and wide again, makes room and punches it to deep cover
drags it short and spins away, bunts it down to deep cover
gets wide of the crease and fires it in full on middle, turns it to midwicket
third man into the act again, bowled on a good length outside off, run down
banged in short outside off, got on to top of it nicely to play it down to third man
good length on middle and leg, pushed back to the bowler
again, identical result to an identical ball, tries to dab it down to third man but is a little late on the shot
short of a good length outside off, holds its line, Dravid tries to chop that down to third man, misses
good stuff, followed that up with one banged in short outside off, Kohli backed away from it
fired it in full again, an attempted yorker outside off, bowled at 140.3 kmph, setting pretty high speed standards for Indian bowlers here, dug out towards third man
short of a good length on leg stump, turned away wide of square leg, there's a fumble but the fielder recovers well to prevent the second
fires in a yorker at 140.7 kmph, shrieks as he bowls indicating the effort, Dravid has no trouble flicking it to fine leg
short of a length on leg and angling it into the right hander, dropped into the off side for a single
good length on the off stump, eased through to deep cover off the back foot
cut back in sharply from outside off, defended it onto the pitch a little awkwardly in the end

massive blow! Short of a length on middle, goes for the pull, replays show that was he was perhaps into the shot a little too early, mistimed it towards midwicket where Niraj Patel dived forward to pouch a good catch inches from the ground
fielded superbly by Warne at cover, driven straight towards him, but with some force, and he sticks his right hand out to save a couple of runs
short of a good length on the off, nudged down to third man for a single
eased through the off side into the covers for a single
and gets smashed, overpitched outside off and Pietersen drives it with utter contempt through the extra-cover region
Munaf lets out a deceptive grunt as he delivers, it's a slower ball outside off, a legcutter that Dravid tries to run down to third man, but misses
good length on the off stump, takes a couple of steps forward and pushes it past Munaf for a single to long-off
overpitched on middle and he's cashed in on the length, drills it fiercely down the ground past the bowler for a boundary
good length outside off and swinging away, KP chases and looks to bludgeon it through the covers, fails to reach it, a wide not given
short of a good length outside off, dabbed down to third man for a single
superb shot but just for a run, full on the off stump, plays a sublime off drive but straight towards long-off
classy, that's his trademark shot, length ball on middle, he bends forward, closes the face and drives it delectably between midwicket and mid-on
pushed off the back foot wide of cover for a single
banged in short on middle, Pietersen had shaped himself up for a pull but realised that it had bounced much more than he expected, ducked at the last moment
gets forward and bunts it between point and cover for a single
good length on the off, defended cautiously off the front foot

the outfield is quick, full on the off stump, tries to drive it much straighter but the bat turns in his hand, ends up opening the face and playing it wide of mid-off, though it didn't go where he wanted to, there was enough pace on the ball to take it to the ropes
full and wide, chases it, goes for a blazing drive that ends up being totally the opposite, rolls down to cover, totally mistimed
banged in short on middle, dropped down into the off side with soft hands for a quick single
straying on the pads to Dravid and pays the price, clips it away fine, fine leg's not as fine as he usually is, gets a boundary
fuller outside off, crunched through the off side wide of mid-off for a single, good sound of bat hitting ball, but wasn't hit as well
mistimes a pull, the shot was on, banged in short on middle and Pietersen went after it, though he didn't hit it as well, he still found the gap to beat fine leg and square leg
short of a good length on middle, nurdles it behind square for a couple
length ball on the off stump, blocked solidly back to the bowler
Uthappa throws it away, length ball on the off and his eyes lit up, tried to waft that across the line over midwicket, got the top edge and Rawat didn't have to move much to snap that
pushed from the crease towards mid-on for a single
almost plays on, angling into the right hander, he hasn't got any room whatsoever, jags back in after landing on middle and off, tries to cart that over mid-on, gets an inside edge onto his pads
short of a good length on middle and off, pushed back to the bowler on the front foot
plays the paddle scoop, fullish on middle, shuffles, bends and plays it away wide of fine leg
slower ball bowled on a good length outside off, dabbed towards cover for a quick single, Munaf starts well too
full on middle and off, aiming for a yorker there, played back to the bowler
turned away off the back foot in the direction of square leg for a quick single
almost had him there, short on middle, looks to work it away on the leg side, gets a leading edge that falls just short of cover
slower ball bowled on a good length outside off, at105.2 kmph, a legcutter that, left alone
fullish on the off stump, pushes it towards point
good length on the off stump, defended watchfully towards cover, excellent over
much fuller on the off stump, tries to force it through the leg side, mistimes it to midwicket
kept a little low, bowled from close to the stumps and lands it on the off, moves in a touch but KP handles it well, defending it back to the bowler
gets it outside off this time, pushed off the front foot to cover
wristily flicks it fine, took it from middle, it was angling into him and dispatched it with a whip wide of fine leg
shuffles to the off and tickles it short of midwicket for a quick single, bowled full on the pads
pitched it up this time, on middle and leg, turned away wide of midwicket for a couple, decent first over by Kamran
short of a good length on the off, pushed firmly in the direction of a deepish mid-off for a single
bouncer banged in short on middle, at 134.3 kmph, ducks under it well
back of a length on the off, punched into the off side wide of mid-off for a single
much fuller on leg stump, tries to whip it away, gets struck on the pads but he steals a leg bye
gets it right, short of a length on middle and leg, works up a good pace upfront, 130.2 kmph, a bit of a slinger this guy, gets the batsman on the ribs as he tries to work it away
short of a good length on the off stump, pushed towards cover from the crease
shot! Straying on the pads, moves across and flicks it disdainfully over midwicket to get his team off the mark
he survives, shaping it away from the right hander this time, landed on a length outside off and moved away, left alone

Dimitri you beauty!! Timber! Landed on a good length on the off stump and moved back in, Taylor walked across to clip it fine, missed it completely and leg stump went for a walk. He's on a hat-trick now
gone! Early damage for Bangalore, pitched on a teasing length outside off and darted back in to kiss the inside edge as Ryder came forward to push at it, and Rawat made no mistake behind the stumps
landed on a good length outside off and left Ryder after pitching, left alone
five-for for Kumble, tossed it up outside off, Rawat tried to swing it over midwicket, got a thin edge that was snapped up easily by Uthappa
Kamran turns it away wide of short fine for a couple more, full on middle and leg
full and wide, sliced away wide of point, deep point gives chase and cuts it off, but they've taken two
slower ball bowled on a good length on the off, drives it through the line back to the bowler
full on the off, pushed back to Ryder
length ball on the off stump, driven firmly back to the bowler who palms it wide of mid-off to allow them sneak a single
short of a good length on the off, pushed to point
flighted outside leg stump, tickled wide of short fine
Kumble takes his fourth, tossed up and Munaf's eyes lit up immediately, landed on a length on middle and he had a massive swing at it, mistimed it and Steyn ran well in from long-on to cup that
pushed through quick on middle, defended into the off side
googly, deceives Warne in the flight, he charges forward to swipe it over midwicket, misses, Uthappa takes it cleanly and clips the bails to take Bangalore to the brink here
short of a length on the off, punched through the covers for a single
on the off stump, slightly short, played back to the bowler
on the off stump, steered to point off the front foot
length ball on middle, pushed firmly to long-on again
slower one bowled full on middle, driven down the ground to long-on
on middle and leg and going down, tried to turn it into the leg side, was hit on the pads
short outside off, cut away wide of third man behind point for a couple
short of a length on the off and moved back in, dropped into the leg side for a single
bowled it short outside off this time, tried to chop it wide of point, missed
three in a row, tossed up and lands full on middle, driven firmly but back to the bowler
flighted on the off, struck back to Kumble again
quicker one on the off, handled well by Warne, defended back to the bowler

That should seal it for Bangalore, gave it air this time unlike the previous one where he bowled it flat and short, Jadeja got down on one knee and tried to slog-sweep it over deep midwicket, got a lot of elevation and though it was struck well, didn't get the distance he desired, Kohli ran well to his right to take a neat catch well inside the ropes

is that the end now? Kumble pulled it short outside off and Yusuf attempted to swat it back over the bowlers head, hit the toe-end of the bat, skied it towards long-off where Ryder took a good catch running forward
just a fraction short on the off stump, cuts it over point wide of third man for a couple, the best over of the innings, though they'll need few more of these
short and wide, kept a little low as he tried to cut that past point, also had to reach for it, missed
short on the off, dabbed short of cover for a quick single
four for Yusuf now, on middle and he wafts it behind square, beats short fine to the boundary
short of a length outside off, slashed away to third man
that's disappeared, just slightly outside off, he plants his foot forward and has a mighty swing at it, pays off as he clears long-on by a mile, they needed that badly
bouncer banged in short outside off, it's too high and is given a wide
the googly there but Yusuf spotted it, on and outside off and he presented the full face to play it back to Kumble
flighted on middle and off, pushed wide of midwicket for a single
gave it some air to bring him forward, landed outside off and spun in but struck him just outside the line as he tried to turn it wide of midwicket
short and quick on middle, mistimes a pull short of deep midwicket
flighted on the off stump, pushed between point and cover for a single
tossed up outside off, swept down to fine leg
probing him outside off, gets forward and defends it to point
on and outside off, Jadeja pushes it to cover

run out, Rajasthan in tatters now, utter confusion out in the middle, played to point off the back foot and Dimitri sets off for a single but there's absolutely no response from the non-striker, he's more than halfway down the pitch and an accurate throw to the keeper from Kohli seals his fate

the slower one does the trick, bowled at 104.8 kmph, landed on a length on middle and Henderson swung across the line, didn't pick the change in pace, missed it as he was a little early into the shot and the ball crashed into middle
short of a length outside off, chopped down to deep cover
full on the off stump, driven down to long-on
on middle and off, swings hard, lofts it wide of long-on for a single, not hit well enough but they're trying to get a move-on now, about time
length ball on the off stump, driven crisply down the ground towards Pietersen at mid-off and they steal a quick single
Vinay screams as he thinks Yusuf has played on, but he hasn't, drew him forward and got it nip back in to kiss the inside edge, it struck him on his pads and dropped just wide of leg stump
on middle and off, shuffles a touch to defend it solidly back to the bowler
short of a length outside off, punched wide of point for a single

the first boundary of the innings, and it's a six that's caught by deep midwicket, slightly short on middle, pulls it away powerfully but Akhil in the deep is over the ropes as he pouches it, it cleared the ropes quite easily
chopped wide of point for a couple wide of deep cover
came back in this time, landed a touch fuller outside off and struck him just outside the line as he tried to play forward
short outside off, goes for the cut, good bounce for the bowler takes it just past the outside edge
short of a good length on the off, defended to cover on the front foot
bouncer down leg stump, given a wide

trouble for Rajasthan, length ball on the off and Patel, in an act of desperation really, tries to clear mid-on but is unable to do so as there's a tall Anil Kumble guarding that area, takes it on the second attempt
good length on the off stump, pushed into the off side towards cover
short of a length on middle, swatted to midwicket, dot ball again
landed on a good length on middle and moved away to beat the outside edge as he tried to play that off the back foot

dropped, though it wouldn't be fair to call that, just a fraction short outside off, bludgeoned over point, Kohli leaps but it's struck extremely hard, he miraculously gets a hand to it and palms it off to third man
Patel struggling here, teasing line outside off and the batsman is sucked into it, stays rooted to the crease and swings, predictably misses
short of a length outside off, tries to heave it across the line, misses
good length on the off, crunched off the front foot straight to cover
held it back a touch, landed just a fraction short outside off, stood tall and stroked it firmly to mid-off, no run again and Praveen's completed another excellent over
good length on the off stump, struck down the ground to mid-off, he's been kept quiet so far
swung hard at it once again, on middle, short, the pull was on but he missed it to be struck on the thigh
short of a length on the off, drags it over midwicket for a couple, a mistimed pull that but effective
short again and he goes after it this time, trying to hook it in the direction of fine leg, but it's called a no-ball for height
bouncer on middle, too high, he didn't really have to duck much, another dot ball
on middle and leg, pushed through the midwicket region for a single
full on middle and leg, hit through the line to mid-on, struck firmly but straight to the fielder
bouncer banged in short on middle, ducks under it well
ooh, almost, short of a good length on middle, chips it just between midwicket and long-on, gets a single
back of a length on the off and came back in a touch, defended solidly in the direction of cover
Steyn has struggled with his direction here, pushes it way wide of the batsman outside off
short of a length, tries to chop it wide of point, gets some good bounce there to beat the outside edge
good length outside off and moving away, left alone
Bangalore are on top, pitched it short outside off and Smith was tempted into going for the cut, he slashed at it and edged it straight to Dravid waiting at a widish first slip
good length on middle, in Smith's zone, just pushes it firmly to midwicket, no flourish there, he's being cautious
misdirected this time, short of a length outside leg stump and held its line, the umpire initially thought it may have clipped the batsman's pads, but decided to call it in the end
similar but a little wider, Smith lets it go this time, it's far enough
testing line on the off and taking it away from the left hander, defended watchfully into the off side
short of a length on the off, dabbed into the leg side
beauty, shaped it away fro Smith, pitched on the off and swung away just as Smith tried to defend that off the back foot, played inside the line and was beaten
teasing him outside off, looks to drive it but was into the shot a little too early, goes through to the keeper
wide again, short of a length but angles it further away from the batsman, the umpire stretches his arms again
much fuller, driving length and Patel chases it from the crease, the ball moves away to beat the outside edge
short and wide, slashes at it unconvincingly, given a wide though the bowler had the batsman thinking there
bouncer banged in short on middle, Smith ducks under it well
back of a length on the off, dropped down short of cover for a single, South African to South African, and there's a sudden buzz in the crowd
skidded into the left hander after landing on a good length on the off stump, struck him on the thighs as he tried to drop it down on the leg side
short of a length outside off, cutting length but left alone by Niraj Patel, the new man in
good, probing line outside off, Smith restrains himself, letting it go

terrible shot, he's just facing his third ball, good length on middle and off and has a waft at it, looking to heave it over midwicket, mistimed it and it lobbed up towards Kohli at point where he took a dolly
Uthappa keeps well diving to his right, though he has two slips to cover for him, a bit of a waste really, too wide outside off, and went further with the swing
good bounce, landed short outside off, went for the cut straightaway but it bounced more than he expected, missed
bowled on a length outside off, Smith moves across to defend, gets a thick inside edge to fine leg as the ball darts back in a little
short of a good length on the off, dropped dead on the pitch off the back foot
slightly short on leg stump, kept a little low, got his bat down in time to defend it back to the bowler
